title: The SOLD Ledger: High-Performance & Day Boat Edition
description: Miami-based Florida Yachts International launches The SOLD Ledger: weekly luxury yacht sales digest spotlighting high-performance and day-boat transactions.
html:
Market Momentum: Premier Results from The SOLD Ledger

MIAMI, FL – In the world of luxury yachting, “Sold” is more than just a status—it is a testament to market authority and the seamless connection of world-class vessels with their next owners. Florida Yachts International is proud to present the inaugural edition of The SOLD Ledger, a weekly series documenting the premier transactions finalized by our global brokerage team.

This week, we highlight four exceptional sales in the high-performance and versatile day-boat categories, ranging from iconic American powerboats to the next generation of open-deck cruisers.

2022 Cigarette 42’ Auroris

  • Sold by: Ralph Navarro
  • The Details: A masterpiece of offshore performance, this 2022 Cigarette Auroris represented a “like-new” opportunity in the high-performance market. Powered by five Mercury 450R outboards, the vessel is capable of speeds near 70 knots.
  • The Edge: Beyond its raw power, this Auroris featured a premium DS-18 sound system and Garmin electronics, making it as much a social platform as it is a speed machine. Ralph Navarro’s expertise in the performance sector ensured a swift transition for this Miami-based icon.

2015 Intrepid

  • Sold by: Ricardo Llorente & Eduardo Cury
  • The Details: Intrepid has long been the gold standard for Florida boaters, known for their stepped-hull designs and impeccable build quality.
  • The Transaction: Brokered by the powerhouse duo of Ricardo Llorente and Eduardo Cury, this sale highlights the enduring value of the Intrepid brand. Even as a 2015 model, the vessel’s reputation for reliability and style made it a highly sought-after asset in the pre-owned market.

2025 NHD 355 Open Deck

  • Sold by: Ricardo Llorente
  • The Details: Representing the cutting edge of design, the 2025 NHD 355 is defined by its signature “Open Deck” feature, which expands the beam to over 16 feet at the touch of a button.
  • The Edge: This sale underscores the growing demand for “smart luxury.” With its aft grill station, removable barstools, and the ability to sleep four, Ricardo Llorente successfully matched this versatile cruiser with an owner looking for the ultimate sandbar and Bahamas-capable weekender.

2017 Pursuit OS 325 Offshore

  • Sold by: Jose Noy
  • The Details: The Pursuit OS 325 is the perfect blend of a serious fishing machine and a refined family cruiser.
  • The Transaction: Jose Noy facilitated the sale of this 2017 model, proving that well-maintained Pursuits remain a hot commodity. Its dual-purpose nature—capable of offshore runs and elegant sunset cruises—made it the ideal acquisition for a client seeking versatility without compromise.

The FYI Advantage

The market for high-performance outboards and luxury day boats is moving faster than ever. At FYI Yachts, we don’t just list these vessels; we utilize a 30-year network and a global marketing engine to ensure they are SOLD.
